claims.statement: Selected near trees create a smaller default visual clearing while widened-layout callers omit that layer.
The camp uses one cohesive modern tent family: two-person dome, three-person tunnel, and one-person trekking-pole shelter.
The proposed fire pocket keeps a 10-foot fuel-clear circle and at least 15 feet from tent fabric and the stage.
The approved camp moves as one unit to a separate east-rim shelf while the central clearing becomes audience meadow and three named habitat zones.
